title: Artist Management
overview: Home is where you kick your boots off, and for Noah Hunton that home is in Ocala, FL. Naturally, being in the south there is a large influence of country music and with his voice and innate ability to strum the guitar, he was destined for the genre. Noah has been playing solo acoustic concerts and full band shows at local venues on the weekends all over the east coast, opening for known musicians, and performing at festivals, weddings, and private events.
